profile.headline: Software Engineer at Arista Networks, Inc.
profile.summary: Experienced in building reliable systems at scale in both the networking and storage space

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Adding platform independent features to the Arista switch as well as making scaling improvements.

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff
positions.description:
October 2009 - September 2012: Steelhead development for CIFS and Core Infrastructure
January 2006 - October 2009: Developed next generation storage products

positions.title: NetCache Technical Director
positions.description: Software architect for Network Appliance's Bangalore Technology Center staffed with approximately 50 engineers.

positions.title: Senior Member of Technical Staff
positions.description: Netcache lead engineer for GRM product (request routing software).  Added a new object packing layout to improve web caching performance.  Ported Xen to FreeBSD for ONTAP-GX development and added cluster failover/virtualization for FlexCache (NFS proxy file system).

positions.title: Tech Lead/Engineering Manager
positions.description: Architect and lead engineer for SGI's next generation cluster volume manager. Took over engineering manager position during my last 6 months of service.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed and implemented cluster volume manager which scaled to 100's of nodes.  Project lead to integrate SMP nodes into cluster.  Participated in hardware/software bringup of R3k processor.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Enhanced and implemented various features of the AIX kernel.  Project Lead for AIX Kanji project.

educations.degreeName: Master of Information and Data Science
